<articles>
<article id="account-business-name" title="Change your client name">
Your **Client name** appears at the top of every page in Harbour CRM.

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Change the **Client name**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.
</article>
<article id="company-edit-details" title="Edit a company's phone number, website or address">
1. Go to **Companies** and open the company.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Change the **Company name**, **Industry**, **Phone**, **Website** or **Address**.
4. Select **Save company**.

This changes the company's main details only.
</article>
<article id="deal-edit-value" title="Change a deal's value">
1. Go to **Deals** and open the deal.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Enter the new amount in **Value**. Use numbers only, without a currency symbol.
4. Select **Save deal**.

The column totals on the board update straight away.
</article>
<article id="account-client-contact-number" title="Change your client contact number">
Your **Client contact number** is the number Harbour CRM support and billing use to reach you.

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Replace the number in **Client contact number**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.
</article>
</articles>
